schema.description: A condition named in a document, as a point fact on the date the document gives it. Written by hand readings, so far from the clinical notes on pathology requests.

as_written.description: The condition exactly as the document wrote it, abbreviations and case kept: one item of the clinical notes line.

clinical_notes.description: The whole clinical notes line the condition was taken from, verbatim.

condition.description: The condition in the reader's words, lower case, abbreviations spelled out, sometimes with a gloss in brackets (such as that it was the reason for the request). The reader's normalisation of as_written, not the document's text.

context.description: Where in the document the mention sits, in the reader's words. One reading wrote this field and others wrote the same thing as kind; the two say the same.

date.description: The date the reader took for the mention, YYYY-MM-DD; for a pathology request, the date it was requested (the report's Requested or REFERRED field), not the draw date. This is the fact time.

id.description: Identity, chosen by the reader: the lab's prefix, the lab number, "clinical-note", and the condition as a slug.

kind.description: What sort of mention this is and where it sits, in the reader's words (so far always a clinical note on a pathology request). Some readings wrote the same thing as context; the two say the same.

noted_by.description: Who wrote the mention, as the document names them; for a pathology request, the requesting doctor.
